column1: # Wording decisions for the retranslation pack (Script = Retrans).
# Copy this file to disks/jpre/rt_overrides.tsv (gitignored: it holds
# translation text) and add one line per entry, TAB-separated:
# table:  equip acc relic spell enemy menu help   (the mod's tables)
# index:  the mod's index (decimal or 0x..), as in the fit report
# field:  name / desc (equip, acc, relic, spell), name (enemy), str (menu, help)
# action: rt    the retranslation's text as it is, even where it does not fit
#         text  your own wording, in the fifth column (plain text; quotes,
#               digits and punctuation are converted for the US renderers;
# Without a line an entry gets the build's provisional choice: the
